program.name: Three-Way Split
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: An upper day, a lower day and a full-body day in straight sets, round and round.
program.about: Three days that share the work out evenly. The upper day presses and rows, the lower day squats, hinges and lunges, and the full-body day mixes both with a total-body lift. Straight sets with full rests throughout. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
